About Palmer Logistics | Houston, Dallas, Savannah Warehousing

## Palmer Logistics Through the Years

To learn about Palmer Logistics, a look at our history from inception through present day is vital. In that time, while our name and operations have gone through some changes, our principal objective of providing quality services with a personal touch has not.

#### Mid-1960s

Founded as a public warehouse and trucking company primarily serving the grocery and chemical industries in the Houston, TX area under the name Palmer Distribution Services, Inc.

#### 1982

After the passing of founder Frank Rifenschlagger, contract management of operations was assumed by Hermann Services, Inc., a New Jersey-based warehouse and transportation provider since 1927.

#### 1988

Acquired by Hermann Services as part of a regional expansion effort; name changed to Hermann Warehouse Southwest.

#### 2000

Hermann Services divested itself of these operations and the Palmer name was restored, although slightly altered to Palmer Logistics as it is currently known.

#### Today

Under the leadership of Brett Mears, son of the late William Hermann, Palmer Logistics continues to operate under the same fundamental philosophies that have driven our success since inception: Reliability, Customer Service, Uncompromising Integrity.

## Mission & Vision Statements

At Palmer Logistics, our appreciation of and commitment to our customers and employees are expressed in our Mission and Vision Statements.

### Mission Statement:

To provide the ideal level of value to each customer in order to earn the reputation of the premiere third party warehouse in each region of operation.

### Vision Statement:

To empower our employees to maximize their God-given talents for their own betterment, and to provide our customers with exceptional solutions to all their supply chain requirements.

“Adherence to these philosophies in Palmer’s day-to-day operations has enabled us to gain the trust of our customers and employees, alike. Our goal each day is to ensure we continue to earn that trust.”

#### Brett Mears

President

Honor the trust instilled in us by 1.) performing for our customers at a level that reinforces this trust; and 2.) recognizing and rewarding the efforts of our dedicated and productive employees.

### Integrity

Always do the right thing, be professional and accountable in our actions, communications and attitude, both personally and professionally.

### Respect

Establish a reputation for excellence both individually and collectively by treating others as you would like to be treated and treating company resources as if they were your own.

### Service

Always be helpful to others – customers, co-workers, suppliers, carriers – and demonstrate this service mentality through actions, not words.

Optimize your supply chain with our Southeastern U.S. warehousing for chemical, food-grade, and building supplies. Ensure safety and efficiency with our expert solutions. Contact us now to elevate your logistics!

Contact Palmer Logistics | Houston, Dallas, Savannah Warehouses

# Contact Us

For warehousing solutions in Houston, Dallas and Savannah, contact Palmer Logistics.

###### We would love to hear from you! Please fill out this form and we will get in touch with you shortly.

## From The President

“Thank you very much for considering Palmer Logistics. Over the past decade, we have experienced steady growth (185% cumulative) by serving as an extension of our customers’ organization, delivering value-added warehouse solutions to help drive their business growth.

The key to our success is simple: retention of our employees, our greatest asset. Our warehouse and customer service professionals are driven to serve, and they understand that our business will succeed through the steady execution of our customers’ requirements.

Our leadership team is local and highly involved in day-to-day operations to ensure that we are helping our customers solve their distribution needs and challenges.

If you would like to discuss how my team can help with your requirements, please click GET STARTED or call 713-860-0300 (+17138600300). I look forward to the opportunity to work with you and your company in the future.”

Sincerely, Brett M. Mears President, Palmer Logistics
